import { test } from "bun:test";
// Ends almost at once, after 0.3 s of CPU. The loop counts CPU time (process.cpuUsage(), user plus system, in
// microseconds), never wall time: a loaded host gives the process less CPU per second, so a wall-time loop could
// end with almost none. The 10 s wall bound only keeps a starved host from hanging the suite.
test("FAKE-1-AC1 burns", () => {
  const start = process.cpuUsage();
  const wallEnd = performance.now() + 10_000;
  while (performance.now() < wallEnd) {
    const used = process.cpuUsage(start);
    if (used.user + used.system >= 300_000) break;
  }
});
